board.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup board. Create a focused style family board for a Chinese xianxia game UI. This is not a full game screen. Show only a curated family of reusable interface shells arranged on one clean presentation board: one primary button, one secondary button, one story card, one encounter card, one prompt panel, one horizontal notice panel, one small icon frame. Visual direction: calm xianxia interface, muted teal lacquer, ivory parchment centers, aged gold trim, restrained cloud ornaments, slightly weathered painted texture, elegant but not luxury jade, not glossy, not cartoonish, not gemstone fantasy, not bright mobile gacha style. Structure rule: every sample must keep its center clean for dynamic text, ornament only near edges and corners, no text on the assets themselves. Board background may be neutral parchment presentation space, but keep it quiet and flat. No characters, no scenery illustration, no full page screenshot, no UI labels, no watermark.

assets.prompt: Using the exact same visual language as the reference UI family board, create one standalone primary action button shell for a xianxia game UI. Single object only. Front view. Symmetrical left and right ends. Muted teal lacquer center, ivory undertone, aged gold trim, restrained ornamental flourishes near the ends only. Clean central text safe area. No icon. No text. No extra badge. No panel. No card. No scenery. Background must be one perfectly flat solid chroma green matte only, with no gradient, no texture, no shadow touching the background, so the background can be removed cleanly later. Keep the silhouette tightly framed.
